behavior-null-guard.brief: Calling `length(null)` from `src/length.js` crashes with a TypeError instead of returning 0. Missing values should count as length 0. Valid strings and arrays must keep their current length.

behavior-legacy-adapter.brief: Payloads from the legacy API send `legacyId` instead of `id`. `adapt({ legacyId: 7 })` in `src/adapter.js` returns `{ id: undefined }` but should return `{ id: 7 }`. When a payload carries `id`, that value stays authoritative.

behavior-retry-backoff.brief: `delayFor(attempt)` in `src/retry.js` always returns 0, so clients retry in a tight loop (a retry storm). Expected policy: exponential backoff that starts at 1000 ms for attempt 0 and doubles per attempt, capped at 30000 ms. For example, `delayFor(1)` must be 2000.

behavior-page-slice.brief: Each page drops its last item: `page([1, 2, 3, 4], 0, 2)` in `src/page.js` returns `[1]` instead of `[1, 2]`. Repair the slice bounds without changing empty or out-of-range pages.

behavior-cache-overwrite.brief: Setting an existing key keeps the stale value: after `cache.set("a", 1); cache.set("a", 2)`, `cache.get("a")` in `src/cache.js` returns 1 instead of 2. Repair the overwrite without changing reads of missing keys.

behavior-retry-limit.brief: `retry(() => false, 3)` in `src/retry.js` makes 4 attempts instead of 3: the helper runs one attempt more than its limit. Retries must stop at the limit, and an early success must still stop immediately.

behavior-unicode-count.brief: `count("a😀")` in `src/count.js` returns 3 instead of 2: emoji count as two characters. Count code points instead, without changing ASCII or empty input.
